note: The Sudan Premier League remains suspended indefinitely due to the ongoing civil war since April 2023. Sudan's biggest clubs (Al Hilal SC, Al Merrikh, Al Ahli Wad Madani) have instead been approved to play in Rwanda's Premier League for 2025-26, and a brief 'elite league' alternative lasting under a month was organised domestically. No organised national league is currently running inside Sudan.
